caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet, oriented with the back facing left and the front facing right. The bonnet is rendered in shades of gray and beige with delicate, fine lines showing the detailed texture and structure. The main body of the bonnet consists of a series of evenly spaced, ribbed sections that arch over the dome of the head, suggesting a quilted or padded fabric. The bonnet is edged and lined with a smoother, softer fabric that forms gathered and ruffled sections around the face opening and at the nape, with a prominent bow tied at the front right. The shading emphasizes the folds and depth of the materials, giving the drawing a three-dimensional appearance. The background is left plain and uncolored, focusing all detail and color on the bonnet itself.
title: Bonnet
